decisions.reason: The dedicated page and several releases right after launch signal active learning and low-cost iteration, so we would keep this option open.
This looks like a niche plugin with weaker market signaling than the others, but as a lightweight add-on its carrying cost is low enough to justify waiting for clearer demand.
Its home-page visibility and clear mobile-usability value suggest strategic relevance, so we would continue to test and refine it rather than exit early.
A GIS solution platform is close to the firm's core business and likely creates option value across many future projects, making withdrawal unlikely after only one year.
A standalone field-data-capture product requires more commercialization effort, but the dedicated page indicates enough commitment to keep it on the market while uncertainty resolves.
The product has dedicated presentation and fits the firm's web-mapping portfolio, so we would retain it as a complementary option unless adoption disappoints more clearly.
